description: ARM A of the owner-approved two-arm relaunch (21 August 2026, second approval - the first was consumed by the stopped 9.57 attempt): the converged base arm of the 9.58-9.61 family, S2 x WEEKDAY at the campaign fraction, 1000 iterations, master seed. Runs CONCURRENTLY with phys1000_arm_b_25pct under the 9.59 two-arm pattern: qsim 8 threads + events 4 per arm (both fit 24 CPUs / 63.5 GiB; each run peaks ~27 GB, so xmx is 30g not 40g - the driver pins -Xms to -Xmx, and two 40g heaps would commit 80g on a 63.5 GiB machine, the measured three-arm pagefile failure of 9.5). Replanning stays at the declared 20 (run identity; the two arms contend during replanning bursts - iteration COUNT survives contention, duration does not, 9.5's measured rule). PassingQ link dynamics and the split thread pools are already in the assembled run inputs. create_graphs off: eight PNGs x 1000 iterations is wall time and disk, never the model; the watch reads the CSVs. This arm re-baselines everything at once: the emergent ride share (now with the 9.60 lifts) against the observed 20.60, walk against 13.40 (#30 re-measures here), the 9.50 constrained base (C5 + report, closing #14/#9), and the #48/#31 realised-boarding and lift ledgers at convergence.
